[`script/Figure6.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/blob/main/script/Figure6.R),
which shares its CITE-seq setup with [Extended Data Figure 6](FigureS6.html) and
[Extended Data Figure 7](FigureS7.html) via
`code/R/citeseq_shared_setup.R`. The code below is shown for
reference (not re-executed on this page, since this script takes about a
minute to run); the images are its pre-rendered output.

```{r fig6-setup, code=code_for("../script/Figure6.R", "doc:setup"), eval=FALSE}
```

Panels (b) onward additionally load the shared CITE-seq cell/protein setup:

```{r fig6-setup2, code=code_for("../script/Figure6.R", "Load data"), eval=FALSE}
```

## (a) Protein-signature schematic {#fig6a}

This panel is a hand-drawn schematic, not generated from code.

How the protein factor matrix is estimated is documented in
[Methods: fitting CITE-seq protein programs with fixed scRNA loadings](Methods_FlashierFit_Citeseq.html).

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 6a.** Schematic illustrating how protein signatures were defined for
each GP. Holding the cell-loading matrix L fixed from the GP model, a protein
factor matrix was estimated by EBMF from the paired CITE-seq protein
measurements, Y ≈ LUᵀ (cells × proteins matrix), yielding a protein signature
U (GPs × proteins matrix) for each GP.
:::

## (b, c) KLRG1 modulation across lineages {#fig6bc}

```{r fig6bc-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure6.R", "6b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig6bc-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="49%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/Figure6/6b.png", "assets/Figure6/6c.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 6b, c.** GPs associated with KLRG1 protein expression in CD4, Tregs,
and CD8. Effect-size versus effect-size plots, where each GP's effect size is
the difference in its mean activity between KLRG1+ and KLRG1- cells, comparing
CD8+ T cells (x-axis) with CD4+ T cells (b) or Treg cells (c).
:::

## (d) Genes up- and down-regulated across the CD69-associated GPs {#fig6d}

The ten GPs, and the correlation-based order they are drawn in, are defined once
in `code/R/citeseq_shared_setup.R`, because
[Extended Data Fig. 7a, b](FigureS7.html#figs7ab) show the same GPs in the same
order from a different script:

```{r fig6d-gps, code=code_for("../code/R/citeseq_shared_setup.R", "doc:cd69"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig6d-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure6.R", "6d"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig6d-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/Figure6/6d.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 6d.** Heatmap of the top five most strongly up- and down-regulated gene
scores for ten GPs correlated with CD69 expression, with the left strip
indicating the Spearman correlation between GP activity and CD69 expression.
:::
